proof_body:
by
  intro g a M hg hM ε hε
  have hm : 0 < |M| := abs_pos.2 hM
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hg (|M| / 2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hg (ε * |M| ^ 2 / 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨min δ₁ δ₂, lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂, fun x h0 hx => ?_⟩
  have h3 := h₁ x h0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hx (min_le_left _ _))
  have h4 := h₂ x h0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hx (min_le_right _ _))
  have h5 : |M| - |g x| ≤ |g x - M| := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub M (g x)
  have h6 : |M| / 2 < |g x| := by linarith
  have hgx : g x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, abs_zero] at h6
    linarith
  refine ⟨hgx, ?_⟩
  have e : 1 / g x - 1 / M = (M - g x) / (g x * M) := by field_simp
  rw [e, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_sub_comm M, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  have : ε * (|M| / 2 * |M|) < ε * (|g x| * |M|) := by gcongr
  nlinarith
